tasks.q: How many characters can 7-bit ASCII represent?

a: It has no room for other alphabets, such as Arabic, Chinese or Greek

tasks.q: Why is the gap between A and a exactly 32?
a: It makes converting between upper and lower case easy: just add or subtract 32
32 is the size of a byte
tasks.fb: It's a neat trick built into the character set.

tasks.q: What is the main advantage of Unicode over ASCII?
a: It can represent characters from every writing system, not just English
It uses fewer bits per character
tasks.fb: Coverage is the point of Unicode.

tasks.q: What is the main disadvantage of Unicode?
a: It uses more bits per character, so files are larger
tasks.fb: More bits per character means bigger text files.

tasks.q: How many different characters can 4 bits represent?
A character set has 1,000 characters. How many bits are needed per character?
tasks.fb: 2 to the power 9 is 512, which isn't enough, but 2 to the power 10 is 1,024.

tasks.q: A message has 250 characters stored in 8-bit ASCII. How big is it in bytes?
The same message is stored in 16-bit Unicode. How big is it now?
tasks.fb: Twice the bits per character means twice the size.

items: Represents every writing system in the world
Uses 16 bits or more per character
Enough for English letters, digits and punctuation
tasks.fb: The first 128 Unicode codes are the same as ASCII, for compatibility.

info.title: Morse code first
info.text: Character codes are older than computers: Morse code assigned patterns of dots and dashes to letters in the 1830s.

info.title: Control codes
info.text: The first 32 ASCII codes aren't printable: they're instructions such as carriage return, line feed and tab.

info.title: Emoji are characters
info.text: Every emoji has a Unicode code point, which is why they can be typed, searched and sorted like letters.

info.title: UTF-8
info.text: The most common way to store Unicode, UTF-8, uses one byte for ASCII characters and more for others, keeping English text small.

info.title: Mojibake
info.text: When text turns into strange symbols, it's usually because it was saved in one character set and read in another.

info.title: Sorting
info.text: Because A is 65 and a is 97, a simple sort puts all the capitals before the lower-case letters.
